title: Canonical field-system tensor data and proper/open projection factors
statement: Fix a purity finite setting P [def-pur-conventions] and simultaneous field-system models D [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models]. A ProjectionTensorComparisons datum consists of the natural signed tensor symmetry on each scheme and field, normalized on every homogeneous K-flat tensor generator by (-1)^(ab), and a strong scalar tensor comparison for each field inclusion, with its ScalarTensorComparisonModel pure-tensor and K-flat normalization [def-coef-semilinear-system-models, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. The left compact-support projection and its scalar target comparison are the original leftProjection and projectionTarget. ProjectionSystemSquare and InvertedProjectionSystemSquare are the original equality predicates. For a scheme morphism g, leftProper is the counit-defined proper projection conjugated by source and target symmetry. For a compactification c=(j,p), leftOpen is inverse source symmetry, the specified open tensor comparison, the pullback compositor j^*p^* to f^*, and extension of target symmetry. Thus the compact-support left projection factors as leftProper followed by proper image of leftOpen. These are explicit words, with no existence or coherence law postulated.
